governance_id.description: Stable unique identity for this governance record

governance_type.description: Type of governance process — process records, not state changes

challenge_type.description: For challenge records — nature of the challenge

challenge_status.description: Current status of this governance process

resolution.description: Resolution outcome — null if still open. upheld=challenge rejected, molecule survives. rejected=challenge accepted.

challenger_trust_score.description: C-9 input: challenger domain trust score at time of challenge (0.0-1.0)

challenge_evidence_depth.description: C-9 input: depth and specificity of evidence payload (0.0-1.0)

challenge_novelty.description: C-9 input: how novel this challenge type is for this molecule (0.0-1.0)

challenger_challenge_history.description: C-9 input: fraction of this challenger's prior challenges that were upheld (0.0-1.0)

observation_refs.description: observation_ids that informed this governance action

actor_trust_score.description: Snapshot of governance actor trust at time of record

challenger_id.description: For challenge records — who raised the challenge

challenger_domain_id.description: For challenge records — which domain raised the challenge

quorum_domains.description: domain_ids forming the governance quorum for this decision

quorum_threshold.description: Minimum quorum size required for this governance tier

evidence_payload_hash.description: Hash of the challenge evidence payload

resolution_rationale.description: Human-readable governance rationale for the resolution

resulting_fact_id.description: fact_id of the JournalFact this governance record produced — null if still open

escalation_tier.description: Governance tier per C-10: 0=autonomous, 1=threshold-triggered, 2=human required, 3=constitutional quorum

constitution_version.description: Constitution version operative at time of governance record

governance_hash.description: Hash of this record chained with prior entry hash

prior_entry_hash.description: Hash of the immediately preceding journal entry
